==Mythos Source==
The monster version of the Lloigor first appeared in ''The Return of the Lloigor'' (1969), written by Colin Wilson. The name Lloigor first appeared in ''Lair of the Star Spawn'' (1932), written by August Derleth and Mark Schorer, where it's a twin being to [[Zhar]].
